pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Uhr" mean in "sechs Uhr"? (1 mark)
   A. month
   B. o'clock
   C. week
   D. day

2. Which words are always written with a capital letter in German? (1 mark)
   A. Small words like und
   B. Adjectives
   C. Nouns
   D. Verbs

3. Which form completes "Du ___ nett"? (1 mark)
   A. bin
   B. bist
   C. ist
   D. sind

4. Which German word or phrase means "parents"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschwister
   B. die Eltern
   C. die Familie
   D. das Kind

5. What is the plural of "das Bett"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bette
   B. die Betts
   C. die Betten
   D. die Better

6. Which is the correct way to write "living room"? (1 mark)
   A. die Wohnzimmer
   B. das Wohnzimmer
   C. der Wohnzimmer
   D. das Wohnzimer

7. Which German word or phrase means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. der Schrank
   B. der Garten
   C. das Zimmer
   D. der Tisch

8. What do you hear in a word if it is spelled "ei"? (1 mark)
   A. the sound ow
   B. the sound oy
   C. the sound ee
   D. the sound eye

9. Which German word means "to smell"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lernen
   B. duschen
   C. riechen
   D. trinken

10. Which sentence is correctly written? (1 mark)
   A. Ich möchte tanzen.
   B. Ich möchtet tanzen.
   C. Ich möchte tanze.
   D. Ich möchte tanzt.

11. Which ordinal means "tenth"? (1 mark)
   A. der elfte
   B. der zehnte
   C. der achte
   D. der neunte

12. Which German word or phrase means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. der Kakao
   C. der Kohl
   D. die Orange

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Kakao"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

14. Which German word or phrase means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. der Rücken
   B. das Ohr
   C. der Kopf
   D. die Schulter

15. What is the plural of "die Hand"? (1 mark)
   A. die Hands
   B. die Hander
   C. die Hände
   D. die Hande

16. Which little word goes with the noun "Gesicht"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. der
   D. das

17. Which little word goes with the noun "Wetter"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. den
   D. das

18. Which German word or phrase means "snow"? (1 mark)
   A. der Wind
   B. der Regen
   C. die Sonne
   D. der Schnee

19. How do you ask "Where is the ball?" (1 mark)
   A. Was ist der Ball?
   B. Wo ist der Ball?
   C. Wer ist der Ball?
   D. Wie ist der Ball?

20. What does "unter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in front of
   B. above
   C. under
   D. on

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mouth, door. (2 marks)

22. Explain the difference between "Es regnet" and "Es ist regnerisch". (2 marks)

23. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sky, cooker. (2 marks)

24. Write the German words with der, die or das for: family, cabbage or kale, toilet, fog, bed. (5 marks)

25. Write the plural of Fuß, Zahn and Auge. (3 marks)

26. Write the German words with der, die or das for: toe, song, juice, egg, water. (5 marks)

27. Write the forms of "sein" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

28. Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words. (4 marks)

29. Write the German words with der, die or das for: foot, head. (2 marks)

30. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandfather, plate. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — o'clock
   sechs Uhr is six o'clock.

2. C — Nouns
   All German nouns begin with capital letters.

3. B — bist
   du goes with bist.

4. B — die Eltern
   parents in German is die Eltern.

5. C — die Betten
   The plural of das Bett is die Betten.

6. B — das Wohnzimmer
   Wohnzimmer is a das noun and begins with a capital letter.

7. B — der Garten
   garden in German is der Garten.

8. D — the sound eye
   ei sounds like eye.

9. C — riechen
   to smell in German is riechen.

10. A — Ich möchte tanzen.
   After möchte comes the -en form tanzen.

11. B — der zehnte
   zehn is ten, zehnte is tenth.

12. A — das Fleisch
   meat in German is das Fleisch.

13. C — der
   It is der Kakao, so the little word is der.

14. B — das Ohr
   ear in German is das Ohr.

15. C — die Hände
   The plural of die Hand is die Hände.

16. D — das
   It is das Gesicht, so the little word is das.

17. D — das
   It is das Wetter, so the little word is das.

18. D — der Schnee
   snow in German is der Schnee.

19. B — Wo ist der Ball?
   wo means where.

20. C — under
   unter means under.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Mund, die Tür.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Es regnet uses a verb and means it is raining. Es ist regnerisch uses an adjective and means it is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Himmel, der Herd.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Familie, der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Füße, die Zähne, die Augen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Zeh, das Lied, der Saft, das Ei, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich bin, du bist, er ist.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, der Kopf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Opa, der Teller.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
